assertions: Task204 imports modern ODF scalar content directly through native Calc document/body/table/row/cell/paragraph context boundaries and ScDocumentImport. Float missing/nonfinite defaults,repeat counts,covered/empty spans,valid sheet names,namespace-resolved same-sheet ODFF source and significant single-line text are represented. Actual SAX namespace resolution is borrowed;cached formula values are recomputed through the supported source-string formula owner rather than a second cached document.
